hints.title: Lookup Set Creation
hints.text: Store all integers from nums inside an efficient element lookup collection.

hints.title: Multiple Iteration
hints.text: Start testing at k and increment by k on each step (k, 2k, 3k, ...).

hints.title: Early Exit
hints.text: Return the first multiple that is absent from the element lookup set.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Hash set insertion and incremental candidate probe bounded by N steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated linear array searches take quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use hash set for constant-time membership checking.
